subject: 97th Floor Weapons
text: Weapons sold at the 97th floor shop have an upgrade limit of 30 times up to +15, but stat bonuses cannot be expected and forging takes too much effort.

evidence.quote: 1つ目は97層の店売り品。強化限界が30回(ただし強化は＋15まで)。付与効果やステータス補正には期待できず、鍛えるのに手間が掛かり過ぎるのが弱点。
evidence.translation: The first is sold at the 97th floor shop. The upgrade limit is 30 times (though upgrades go up to +15). Stat bonuses and bonus effects cannot be expected, and forging takes too much effort, which is its weakness.

subject: 99th Floor Weapons
text: Weapons sold at the 99th floor shop are already enhanced up to +15 with bonus effects, leaving no room for further upgrades.

evidence.quote: 2つ目は99層の店売り品。＋15まで強化されており、付与効果も武器ごとに異なる＋15のものが付いている。強化の余地がないのが弱点。
evidence.translation: The second is sold at the 99th floor shop. They are strengthened up to +15 with different +15 bonus effects per weapon, but having no room for further enhancement is the weakness.

subject: Contest and Original Weapons
text: Contest-adopted and original novel weapons have high attack power and large parameter bonuses, but cannot be upgraded and have long attack intervals.

evidence.quote: 3つ目はコンテスト採用武器＆原作武器。攻撃力が高くパラメータへの補正も大きいが、強化不能の上攻撃間隔が長めなのが弱点。
evidence.translation: The third is contest-adopted weapons and original novel weapons. Attack power is high and parameter corrections are large, but being unable to upgrade and having long attack intervals is the weakness.

subject: Duel Series Armor
text: The Duel series armor has high parameter corrections and defense approaching heavy armor, is sold on the 92nd floor, and parts other than feet can be obtained earlier via LA.

evidence.quote: デュエルシリーズ：パラメータ補正が高く、重装鎧に迫る防御力を持つ。安定の黒ずくめ。92層で販売。足以外はLAでもっと早期に入手可。
evidence.translation: Duel series: Parameter correction is high and possesses defense approaching heavy armor. Sold on 92nd floor. Parts other than feet can be obtained earlier via LA.

subject: Chaos Series Armor
text: The Chaos series armor provides tremendous boosts to attack power and STR with many negative penalties, has lower defense than the Duel series, and all pieces are LA items.

evidence.quote: カオスシリーズ：攻撃力とSTRに絶大な補正がかかる。マイナス補正が多く、全身鎧だが防御性能はデュエルシリーズに劣る。全てLA品。
evidence.translation: Chaos series: Tremendous bonuses to attack power and STR. Many minus penalties, and although full body armor, defense performance is inferior to the Duel series. All are LA items.

subject: Bloody Necklace
text: The Bloody Necklace grants HP regen +200, is a Last Attack item, and is later sold in shops for 1200万 Col.

evidence.quote: ブラッディネックレス：HPリジェネ＋200。LA品だが後に店でも1200万コルで販売。
evidence.translation: Bloody Necklace: HP regen +200. An LA item, but later sold in shops for 1200万 Col.

subject: Cross Necklace
text: The Cross Necklace grants an SP regen effect and is sold on the 82nd floor for 2800万 Col.

evidence.quote: クロスネックレス：SPリジェネ効果。82層で販売だが、2800万コルのため1周目では到達即購入は困難。
evidence.translation: Cross Necklace: SP regen effect. Sold on the 82nd floor, but because it costs 2800万 Col, buying it immediately upon arrival on playthrough 1 is difficult.

subject: Full Face
text: The Full Face provides defense +20 as a Last Attack bonus item belonging to the Chaos series set.

evidence.quote: フルフェイス：防御＋20。カオスシリーズのセットでありLA品。
evidence.translation: Full Face: Defense +20. It is a set piece of the Chaos series and an LA item.

subject: Iron Mask
text: The Iron Mask gives defense +30 as part of the Alliance Mail set and is sold in shops for 50万 Col.

evidence.quote: 鉄仮面：防御＋30。店売りでたったの50万コル。フルフェイスの完全上位互換だが、凄まじくカッコ悪い。アライアンスメイルのセット。
evidence.translation: Iron Mask: Defense +30. Sold in shops for only 50万 Col. Complete upward compatibility to Full Face, but looks terrible. Set piece of Alliance Mail.

subject: Infinite Ankh
text: The Infinite Ankh grants attack and defense +250, all stats +25, and hit and evasion +8%, sold on the 76th floor for 9000万 Col limited to 1 during 99th floor progression.

evidence.quote: インフィニットアンク：攻防＋250、全ステータス＋25、命中回避＋8％の破格性能だがお値段なんと9000万。76層にて99層攻略中1個のみの限定販売。
evidence.translation: Infinite Ankh: Attack and defense +250, all stats +25, hit and evasion +8% exceptional performance, but costs 9000万. Limited sale of only 1 piece on the 76th floor during 99th floor capture.

subject: Dragon Cloak
text: The Dragon Cloak grants STR +6, VIT +12, attack +15, defense +50, poison +5%, paralysis +5%, and bleed +5%, sold in the 88th floor shop.

evidence.quote: ドラゴンマント：STR+6 VIT+12 攻撃+15 防御+50 毒+5% 麻痺+5% 出血+5%。防御力とステータスならこれ。88層の店売り品。
evidence.translation: Dragon Cloak: STR+6 VIT+12 attack +15 defense +50 poison +5% paralysis +5% bleed +5%. Choose this for defense and stats. Sold at the 88th floor shop.

subject: Hyper Ring
text: The Hyper Ring provides STR +10, VIT +5, DEX +10, AGI +15, attack +30, defense +12, and evasion +8% as an LA reward item.

evidence.quote: ハイパーリング：STR+10, VIT+5, DEX+10, AGI+15, 攻撃+30, 防御+12, 回避+8%と安定の一品。LA品。
evidence.translation: Hyper Ring: STR+10, VIT+5, DEX+10, AGI+15, attack +30, defense +12, evasion +8% reliable item. LA item.

subject: Might Ring
text: The Might Ring provides STR +40 and attack +10 as the reward for the 79th floor Labyrinth 2nd floor mission.

evidence.quote: マイトリング：STR+40 攻撃+10。攻撃重視なら1週目ではハイパーリングとこれ。79層 迷宮区2階ミッションの報酬。
evidence.translation: Might Ring: STR+40 attack +10. If prioritizing attack in 1st playthrough, this and Hyper Ring. Reward of 79th floor Labyrinth 2nd floor mission.

subject: Guardian Ring
text: The Guardian Ring grants VIT +5 and defense +40, sold in the 77th floor shop.

evidence.quote: ガーディアンリング：VIT+5 防御+40。マイトリングの代わりにこれもあり？77層の店売り品。
evidence.translation: Guardian Ring: VIT+5 defense +40. An alternative to Might Ring. Sold at the 77th floor shop.

subject: Dragon Scale Belt
text: The Dragon Scale Belt provides STR +10, VIT +20, attack +10, and defense +40, sold in the 98th floor shop.

evidence.quote: ドラゴンスケイルベルト：STR+10 VIT+20 攻撃+10 防御+40。防御力ならこれ。98層の店売り品。
evidence.translation: Dragon Scale Belt: STR+10 VIT+20 attack +10 defense +40. Choose this for defense. Sold at the 98th floor shop.

subject: Button Shortcuts
text: Pressing L and R simultaneously followed by Triangle in a dungeon displays the map, while pressing Circle opens the item menu.

evidence.quote: ダンジョン内でLR同時押し→△でMAP表示。メニューから開くより早い。○だと[アイテム](//w.atwiki.jp/sao-im/pages/96.html "アイテム \(3576d\)")メニューが開く。
evidence.translation: In dungeons, pressing L and R simultaneously followed by Triangle displays the MAP. Faster than opening from menu. Circle opens the item menu.

subject: Partner Growth Screen
text: Pressing Triangle on field areas outside town opens the partner growth screen to inspect parameters raised by GOOD praises.

evidence.quote: 街以外のフィールドで△を押すと[パートナー](//w.atwiki.jp/sao-im/pages/58.html "パートナー \(4659d\)")の成長画面（GOODで伸びるアレ）を確認できる。
evidence.translation: Pressing Triangle on fields other than town lets you check the partner growth screen that increases with GOOD.

subject: Item Auto-Sort
text: Items in the inventory can be auto-sorted by pressing Triangle, although no button help appears on screen.

evidence.quote: 画面にボタンヘルプは出ないが、アイテムは△で自動ソート可能。
evidence.translation: Although button help does not appear on screen, items can be auto-sorted with Triangle.

subject: Sword Skill Menu
text: Sword Skills can be edited with Triangle and rearranged with Square, just like Battle Skills.

evidence.quote: 同じく画面にボタンヘルプは出ないが、ソードスキルも[バトルスキル](//w.atwiki.jp/sao-im/pages/55.html "バトルスキル \(3590d\)")同様、△でエディット、□で並べ替えが可能。
evidence.translation: Similarly no button help appears on screen, but Sword Skills, just like Battle Skills, can be edited with Triangle and rearranged with Square.

subject: Sword Skill Removal
text: To remove a Sword Skill from the list, open edit with Triangle, press Triangle again to set no skill, and confirm changes.

evidence.quote: リストから消したい場合は△でエディットを開く→もう一度△でスキルなしの状態にして、変更を確定。
evidence.translation: If you want to erase from the list, open edit with Triangle, press Triangle once more to make it a state with no skill, and confirm the change.

subject: Dialogue and Movie Controls
text: Holding the L button fast-forwards dialogue, pressing START skips movies, and pressing R hides the text window during event conversations.

evidence.quote: Lボタンで早送りができる。...STARTでムービー飛ばし、イベント会話時にRでテキストウィンドウ非表示となる。
evidence.translation: Fast-forward can be done with L button. START skips movies, and pressing R during event conversations hides the text window.

subject: GOOD Praise Color
text: Partner praise text during battle is color-coded red for attack actions, blue for defense actions, and green for buff and recovery actions.

evidence.quote: 赤→アタック系（主に攻撃系ソードスキルや連携・スイッチなど）...青→ディフェンス系（ヘイトを稼ぐ行動、主に防御に関わる強化を使用するなど）...緑→バフ系（回復や各種弱体、スタンや封印の行動阻害）
evidence.translation: Red is attack system (mainly offensive sword skills, coordination, switch). Blue is defense system (actions earning hate, mainly using defense buffs). Green is buff system (recovery, debuffs, stun, seal disruption).

subject: Target Lock Release
text: Pressing X once releases target lock, turning the reticle cursor from purple to yellow and allowing normal field running speed with weapon drawn.

evidence.quote: 戦闘時は移動が遅くなるが、一度×を押してターゲットロックを解除（敵に合わせたカーソルが紫→黄色になる）すると...抜刀したままフィールド移動時と同じ速度で移動することが可能。
evidence.translation: Movement is slow during combat, but pressing X once releases target lock (cursor aimed at enemy changes from purple to yellow), allowing movement at the same speed as field movement while weapon is drawn.

subject: Target Lock Release Tactics
text: Releasing target lock allows dodging enemy skills without step skills, or selecting another target with D-pad left and right to inflict stun or seal.

evidence.quote: このロック解除は敵のスキルをステップ等のバトルスキルを使わず避けたい場合に便利なほか、...敵がPT単位の際にはロック解除→十字キー左右で別対象を選択→スタン・封印を入れ元の敵をロックし直して攻撃、という小技にも使える。
evidence.translation: This lock release is convenient when wanting to avoid enemy skills without using battle skills like steps, and against enemy party groups it can be used to release lock, select another target with D-pad left and right, apply stun or seal, and re-lock the original enemy to attack.

subject: Target Lock Release Attack Accuracy
text: Attacks made while target lock is released can miss completely if Kirito does not have the enemy directly in front of him.

evidence.quote: 解除した状態でも攻撃できるが、対象をしっかりキリトさんの正面に捉えておかないと空振ることも多いため注意。
evidence.translation: You can attack in the released state, but take caution as attacks often miss if the target is not captured directly in front of Kirito.

subject: Combat Disengagement
text: Pressing X twice stops attacking and sheathes the weapon, allowing escape from combat.

evidence.quote: ×を二度押すと攻撃を中止し、納刀する。こちらは逃走したい際にどうぞ。
evidence.translation: Pressing X twice stops attacking and sheathes the sword. Use this when wanting to escape.

subject: Level Correction
text: The game applies a level difference correction that adds positive or negative modifiers to damage, hit rate, and evasion rate based on level differences.

evidence.quote: これは対象とのレベル差に応じて、ダメージや命中・回避率その他にプラス、あるいはマイナスの補正がかかるという仕様。
evidence.translation: This is a specification where positive or negative corrections apply to damage, hit rate, evasion rate, and others depending on the level difference with the target.

subject: Assault Team Leveling
text: Assault Team parties gain experience over in-game time, but because their levels start low upon reaching a new floor, players should assist them for about 2 levels to prevent party member deaths.

evidence.quote: 攻略組PTはゲーム内時間の経過に応じて地道に経験値を稼いでいるので、一切手伝わず数時間放置しておくだけでも...ギルド画面の戦力値・精鋭の数が増えたり、レイド参加予定PTの顔ぶれが大きく変わったりする。...階層が上がった直後の攻略組PTは元々のレベルが低いため、場所によっては気付かぬうちに戦死者が出てしまうことも。...移動直後は放置はせず、2レベル分くらいはつきっきりで手伝って上げた方が無難。
evidence.translation: Assault team parties steadily earn experience as in-game time passes, so even leaving them alone for several hours without helping will increase guild battle values and elite counts, or change raid party members. However, immediately after ascending floors their initial levels are low, so deaths can occur unnoticed, making it safer to assist them continuously for about 2 levels rather than leaving them alone.
